ModMetaData.name: Soundpacks Framework
ModMetaData.author: Sk
ModMetaData.description: Replace the audio clips of vanilla or mod-added sounds with your own, packaged as "soundpacks". Use the in-game Soundpack Manager (in Mod Settings) to import a soundpack from a .zip, or duplicate one into an editable copy: remap any sound to your own MP3, WAV, or OGG files, then export it back to a .zip to share. Other mod authors can also ship a read-only soundpack folder directly inside their own mod, with no code required.
